New Features

  Added Fly Mode to practice mode with a rebindable button.
  Jumping with the scroll wheel is now enabled by default alongside the rebindable jump button.
  Option to display milliseconds on the timer.
  Added a link to the Blocky Ascent Speedrun Leaderboard in the leaderboard tab.
  Version number is now displayed in the pause menu.


Bug Fixes

  Improved performance by fixing various bugs.
  Fixed an issue where custom keybinds wouldn't apply after restarting the game.
  Fixed a bug where sensitivity was affected by FPS.

notes.title: 1.04 Physics Overhaul & Movement Improvements
notes.content:
Physics Update Tick Rate Increased
The physics update tick rate has been changed from 50 to 150.
What does this mean?

 Smoother Movement: Character movement is now more responsive.
 Improved Collision Accuracy: Fewer issues with falling through floors or getting stuck in objects.
 Better Bunnyhopping: You’ll lose less speed during bunnyhops, as less time is spent grounded between jumps.
 Trampoline Adjustments: Trampolines now preserve your current speed more accurately instead of giving a speed boost randomly.

Please note that this change involves more calculations per second, which might slightly impact performance on some devices. However, the accuracy gains should be well worth it!



Map Adjustments

 Updated the map to account for the new movement system. Some jumps and sections that were previously unreachable with the new physics have been adjusted.



Other Improvements

 Camera Smoothing: The camera has been smoothed out to reduce the shaking when walking into walls, making for a more comfortable experience.



As always, I appreciate your feedback! If you notice anything strange or run into issues, let me know via the in-game feedback form.

Happy climbing!

Fixed some areas where it was possible to fall through the floor
 Adjusted the difficulty of the dropper
 Slightly adjusted an anti-gravity field near the end of the game
 Fixed lighting issues
Fixed a bug where jumping on ice platforms wasn't possible with "Hold Jump" disabled
